image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a matte off-white tiled wall above a narrow stone counter edge, soft daylight from the upper left, a faint warm-grey gradient towards the lower right. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.

No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names; no airbrushed or retouched skin and nothing implying a result.
